home.intro: I'm passionate about learning, dancing, and making the world a better place. I'm currently an undergrad at The University of Chicago, President of [UChicago Effective Altruism](https://uchicagoea.org), and Chief of Staff at the [Existential Risk Laboratory](https://xrisk.uchicago.edu).

currently.subtitle: last updated 10/21/26
currently.note1: Recently, I've been thinking about Laffer curve effects. What would give me higher returns when I decrease the quantity but increase the price (quality)? What should I do more of at a lower quality? The answer to this second question is invariably emails, but just about everything seems to be subject to this effect. Or maybe not? Perhaps this gets more complicated with non-homogenous goods... I might write a blog post about this.
currently.note2: In terms of what I'm actually spending time on, ask my calendar: sleep (although significantly less than ever), work (just ran a panel event that went pretty well, now pivoting to symposium planning and academic-year groups), EA organizing (really excited about supporting all the ideas people have for programming, and doing 1-1s), and spending time with friends (taco tuesdays are my favorite). I'm getting increasingly skilled at making cheap vegan meals from home, doing handstands, and reading and predicting my mental state (so watch out— I might become a ninja soon).

projects.subtitle: things I've made, so far
projects.note1: In an attempt to think and write more, I've started [a substack](https://substack.com/@madlenreads?r=5j2qmf&utm_campaign=profile&utm_medium=profile-page). I've found that writing for an audience (albeit a small one) is quite different from writing for myself, and involves a lot more editing. I find the challenge of making my thoughts concise, comprehensible, and engaging a worthwhile one.
projects.note2: I conducted a [sleep data analysis](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mU0Cf0hOIiQYfXzRHgMYZWZ1Axlu6ik3GzpVMstTNCU/edit?usp=sharing) on myself. Long story short, I sleep a lot, and less when I wake up to an alarm. I also expect to become an early riser as I get older. My interest in sleep also manifests in some research on dream theories, which I didn't include in the report.
projects.note3: I spent a summer at [Project Donor](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/sDLvkLMhmmatiqaR7/introducing-project-donor-a-cost-effective-approach-to) helping write a cost-effectiveness analysis on interventions supporting kidney donation. I left considering kidney donation myself, and supporting the [End Kidney Deaths Act](https://www.endkidneydeathsact.org) as the most obviously good policy I'm aware of.

advice.subtitle: from the green notebook
advice.intro: Since 2023, I've been collecting advice from friends and strangers in a green notebook I carried with me almost everywhere. I lost the notebook this summer ([it's a long story](https://madlenreads.substack.com/p/to-the-boy-who-robbed-me?r=5j2qmf&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web)) but by the kindness and foresight of some lovely people, most of the entries have been saved digitally and now exist here. I carry around a new green notebook and would love for you to add your advice to your past self — I will probably request it if I know you in person, but if you ask me to add yours I might cry tears of joy. You're also welcome to [upload your own](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeNC3z4_AFh7Njtp66DmesXIRY3LgctPeOAQP-X7jR5U84RlA/viewform) to this page :)
